milestone.title: Sidebar polish + log pane box + Catppuccin Mocha theme

intent.outcome: The TUI looks unmistakably modern: the active sidebar panel pops via bg tint + accent title, the log pane has its own bordered box with collapse toggle, and the whole palette is Catppuccin Mocha dark (light unchanged).

problem.description: The current sidebar uses only border color to indicate the active panel — easy to miss at a glance. The log pane renders as plain text with no visual identity, eating vertical space when empty. The default theme is generic purple-on-dark, not distinctive. Together these give the TUI an unfinished feel.

in_scope: Switch internal/gui/style/theme.go DarkTheme() to Catppuccin Mocha palette: Accent->Mauve #cba6f7, Secondary->Teal #94e2d5, Success->Green #a6e3a1, Warning->Yellow #f9e2af, Error->Red #f38ba8, Subtle->Overlay0 #6c7086, Text->Text #cdd6f4, Bg->Base #1e1e2e.
Add new style ActivePanelBg = Surface0 #313244 (one shade lighter than Base) for the active sidebar panel row.
Add new style PanelTitleActive = Mauve bold for the active panel title text.
Add new style LogBorder = SubtleColor rounded for the log pane border; AccentColor when commands actively running.
Update internal/gui/render.go renderSidebar() to apply ActivePanelBg background + PanelTitleActive text color to the active panel's title row. No arrow, no border style change.
Update internal/gui/render.go renderMainPanel() to wrap cmdLog in a bordered rounded box with 'Log' title.
Update internal/gui/keybindings.go (or gui.go Update switch) to handle Shift+C: toggle m.logCollapsed.
Update internal/gui/help.go globalHints to include 'C' (collapse log) hint.
Update internal/gui/render.go renderMainPanel() to allocate cmdLogHeight = 0 when logCollapsed, giving the rows to main content.
Add tests: sidebar active styling observable, log pane border observable, Shift+C toggles state, log collapsed state changes height calc.
out_of_scope: Light theme changes (Catppuccin Latte is a separate decision; for now light theme retains current colors).
M16 tab bar redesign, table layouts (separate milestone).
Snapshot test regeneration (not needed: snapshot_test.go is content-based, not golden-file).

acceptance_criteria.description: The active sidebar panel has a visibly different background than inactive panels.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: launch lazybrew, observe sidebar; active panel row has Surface0 (#313244) background tint, inactive rows have Base (#1e1e2e)

acceptance_criteria.description: The active sidebar panel title text uses Mauve accent color, inactive titles use Text color.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: launch lazybrew, observe sidebar; active title is Mauve + bold, inactive titles are Text color

acceptance_criteria.description: The log pane renders as a bordered rounded box with the title 'Log' above its content.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: launch lazybrew, observe bottom of main pane; log region is wrapped in a SubtleColor rounded border with 'Log' title

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing Shift+C toggles the log pane between expanded (default) and collapsed (height 0).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: launch lazybrew, press Shift+C, observe log pane disappears; press Shift+C again, log pane returns

acceptance_criteria.description: When log is collapsed, the main content area gains the freed vertical space.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: launch lazybrew, observe main pane height; press Shift+C to collapse; main pane content area grows to fill

acceptance_criteria.description: The dark theme uses Catppuccin Mocha colors: Accent=Mauve #cba6f7, Bg=Base #1e1e2e, Text=Text #cdd6f4, Subtle=Overlay0 #6c7086, Success=Green #a6e3a1, Warning=Yellow #f9e2af, Error=Red #f38ba8.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cat internal/gui/style/theme.go DarkTheme() values; confirm hex codes match Catppuccin Mocha palette per https://catppuccin.com/palette/

acceptance_criteria.description: Light theme colors are unchanged (deferred to a separate decision).
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cat internal/gui/style/theme.go LightTheme() values; confirm they still match the original (pre-M14) hex codes

design_decisions.choice: bg tint + accent title + bold, no arrow, no border change
design_decisions.rationale: Three layered color signals (bg + text color + weight) read as 'selected' without needing a glyph. Border style change (rounded->thick) would clash with inactive rounded borders; bg+text combo reads cleaner.

steps.action: Replace DarkTheme() color values in internal/gui/style/theme.go with Catppuccin Mocha palette: Accent=#cba6f7 (Mauve), Secondary=#94e2d5 (Teal), Success=#a6e3a1 (Green), Warning=#f9e2af (Yellow), Error=#f38ba8 (Red), Subtle=#6c7086 (Overlay0), Text=#cdd6f4 (Text), Bg=#1e1e2e (Base). Leave LightTheme() unchanged.
steps.tests: manual: grep -E 'AccentColor.*=.*lipgloss.Color' internal/gui/style/theme.go shows the 8 Mocha hex codes; LightTheme block unchanged
steps.done_when: DarkTheme returns Mocha palette; LightTheme unchanged; no other modifications to theme.go in this step

steps.action: Add three new styles in internal/gui/style/theme.go ApplyTheme: ActivePanelBg (Surface0 #313244 with background set), PanelTitleActive (Mauve + Bold), LogBorder (RoundedBorder with SubtleColor foreground). Add them to both Dark and Light themes (using Latte Surface0 #ccd0da for light if logical, else keep Dark-only).
steps.tests: manual: grep ActivePanelBg internal/gui/style/theme.go returns 1+ matches; grep PanelTitleActive returns 1+; grep LogBorder returns 1+
steps.done_when: All three styles are defined and assigned in ApplyTheme

steps.action: Update internal/gui/render.go renderSidebar() so the active panel title row gets ActivePanelBg background + PanelTitleActive text. Inactive panels keep default Bg and Text styles. No arrow, no border change.
steps.tests: manual: launch lazybrew, observe sidebar; active row tinted with Surface0 bg + Mauve title; inactive rows unchanged
steps.done_when: renderSidebar applies ActivePanelBg and PanelTitleActive to active panel title

steps.action: Wrap cmdLog in internal/gui/render.go renderMainPanel() with a Lip Gloss bordered rounded box. Use style.LogBorder for the border. When logCollapsed, allocate cmdLogHeight = 0 so main content fills the space.
steps.tests: manual: launch lazybrew; log region has visible rounded border; press Shift+C to collapse; log disappears and main content grows
steps.done_when: cmdLog renders inside a bordered rounded box; logCollapsed branch returns empty string and mainContentHeight adjusts

steps.action: Add Model.logCollapsed bool field (default false). Add 'case C' in internal/gui/gui.go Update keymap (alongside 'R') that toggles m.logCollapsed and returns. Add 'C' to globalHints in internal/gui/render.go renderBottomBar().
steps.tests: manual: launch lazybrew; press Shift+C; log disappears from view; press Shift+C again; log returns
steps.done_when: Shift+C toggles logCollapsed; bottom help bar shows C hint

steps.action: Add tests in internal/gui/gui_test.go (or new file): (1) renderSidebar with active panel produces output containing the active title text with bg tint marker; (2) renderMainPanel with non-empty log produces bordered output; (3) Update with capital 'C' rune toggles logCollapsed.
